# Conversion Tools

Conversion Tools is an online service that offers a fast and easy way to convert documents between different formats, like XML, Excel, PDF, Word, Text, CSV, and others.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/conversion-tools/.

## Actions

- **Convert Excel to CSV**: Convert excel files to csv.
- **Convert Excel to HTML**: Convert an excel file to html.
- **Convert JPG to JSON with AI**: Convert jpg to structured json using ai.
- **Convert Markdown to HTML**: Convert markdown to html.
- **Convert OXPS to PDF**: Convert an oxps file to pdf.
- **Convert Website to PDF**: Convert a website url to pdf.
- **Convert Website to PNG**: Convert a website url to a png image.
- **Convert Word to Text**: Convert word documents to plain text.
- **Download File**: Download a conversion result file by its id.
- **Upload File**: Upload a file for conversion.
